Slide plan created and saved to `outputs/05_slide_plan.json`.

**Summary: 14-slide proposal deck plan**

The plan follows proposal logic (Why → What → Proof → How → Plan → Risk/Cost → CTA) while aligning with audience priorities (education-focused Sony executive):

| # | Action Title (Assertion Headline) | Visual |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4-week exploratory meeting can validate strategic fit | Decision flowchart with exit gates |
| 2 | AI agents becoming economic actors but no rigorous research exists | Gap diagram (academia/corp/opportunity) |
| 3 | Policymakers will operate blind without empirical data | Timeline: 2025→2030→2040 curriculum |
| 4 | Nyx has proven Ethereum ecosystem execution capability | Credibility badge card (4 quadrants) |
| 5 | Competition creates blockchain research platform for AI agents | L0/L1/L2 framework diagram |
| 6 | Research showcases Soneium while generating educational data | Ecosystem integration diagram |
| 7 | Real-asset stakes create more realistic AI behavior than simulations | Comparison table |
| 8 | Nyx can execute where Google/OpenAI/universities face barriers | 2x2 matrix |
| 9 | Human researchers monitor—AI agents within defined constraints | Governance diagram |
| 10 | Private chain eliminates crypto speculation and brand risk | Scope boundary diagram |
| 11 | Phased roadmap to September 2025 with clear exit gates | Timeline with phases |
| 12 | Key risks have specific mitigations | Risk matrix table |
| 13 | 16M JPY investment generates unique educational research ROI | ROI flow diagram |
| 14 | Next step: Approve meetings and introduce stakeholders | Next steps action card |

**Audience alignment applied:**
- Education/mission impact leads (not tech hype)
- Governance and human-in-the-loop boundaries explicit (SL09-10)
- Soneium complementarity emphasized (SL06, SL08)
- Positions Isozu as champion/introducer to operational decision-makers
- Low-commitment ask (4-week exploratory meetings)
